title: FYI Yachts Welcomes Adelina Lesenciuc as Our New Luxury Yacht Sales and Charter Consultant
description: Welcome Adelina Lesenciuc to FYI Yachts, enhancing our luxury yacht expertise. Her passion and dedication promise exceptional experiences.
html:
FYI Yachts is proud to welcome Adelina Lesenciuc, a seasoned professional in the luxury yacht market, to our growing team. With an exceptional track record in yacht charters and sales, Adelina’s expertise marks a bold step forward in our ongoing mission to deliver world-class experiences to our valued clients.

A Passion for Perfection on the Water

Adelina brings a distinguished background in high-end travel and elite maritime services, with years of hands-on experience in the luxury yacht charter and sales industry. She has built a reputation for designing bespoke yacht charter experiences that exceed expectations. From the shimmering coasts of the Mediterranean to the turquoise waters of the Caribbean, she has successfully matched discerning clients with some of the world’s most prestigious yachts—always with a personal, detail-oriented approach.

Why Adelina?

What truly sets Adelina apart is her unwavering dedication to the client journey, from initial inquiry to disembarkation. She has a proven ability to align each client’s unique lifestyle and preferences with the ideal vessel and professional crew, creating unforgettable charter experiences. Her deep industry knowledge, commitment to excellence, and energetic professionalism align perfectly with FYI Yachts’ gold-standard service philosophy.

Strengthening FYI Yachts’ Charter Division

Adelina’s arrival significantly strengthens our charter division, enhancing our ability to serve a global clientele with refined expertise and personalized attention. As FYI Yachts continues to expand its leadership in luxury yacht sales and charters, we remain focused on investing in top-tier talent that elevates every aspect of the client experience.

Join Us in Welcoming Adelina

We are excited to have Adelina on board and confident in the extraordinary journeys she will help create. Whether you’re chartering a yacht for the first time or acquiring your dream vessel, Adelina is here to ensure every nautical mile is memorable.

Welcome to the FYI Yachts family, Adelina!
